intro: Welcome to the waiting workout! Every wait makes your waiting muscle stronger.
praise: Rep complete! Your waiting muscle just got stronger.
cheer: Waiting workout complete! You are a self-control champion!
train-praise: Great waiting rep! Your muscle is growing.
train-cheer: You used three waiting tricks and got stronger!
train-s1: Place one small treat or favorite toy where you can see it.
train-s2: Ten-second wait! Put your hands on your knees and make them strong and still.
train-s2-after: Ten seconds! Your waiting muscle did its first rep.
train-s3: Twenty-second wait! Look away from the treat and count slowly in your head.
train-s3-after: Twenty seconds! The look-away trick made waiting easier.
train-s4: Thirty-second wait! Sing a favorite song inside your head.
train-s4-after: Thirty seconds! Your waiting muscle is powerful.
train-s5: EAT or PLAY — you earned it, champion! And the bigger win is this: you just got stronger.
master-praise: Master rep complete! Your muscle is GROWING.
master-cheer: You made a strong choice! Taking it now or waiting again can both be celebrated.
master-s1: The one-minute grand wait begins! Choose your best waiting trick for the first fifteen seconds.
master-s1-after: Fifteen seconds! Your muscle is GROWING.
master-s2: Keep going for fifteen more seconds. Sit on your hands or keep them strong on your knees.
master-s2-after: Thirty seconds! Your muscle is GROWING. You are halfway, Waiting Master.
master-s3: Fifteen more seconds. Look away and count slowly in your head.
master-s3-after: Forty-five seconds! Your muscle is GROWING.
master-s4: Final fifteen seconds! Sing inside your head all the way to the finish.
master-s4-after: One whole minute! Your waiting muscle is stronger than ever.
master-s5: Now choose: enjoy the treat, or wait again to make it two. Both choices are strong choices.
master-s6: You chose for yourself! Celebrate your strong waiting muscle!
